name: hermes-agent
description: An AI agent with advanced tool-calling capabilities, featuring a flexible toolsets system for organizing and managing tools.

scripts.ci:js: npm run ci:js:shared && npm run ci:js:tui && npm run ci:js:desktop && npm run ci:js:web && npm run ci:js:bootstrap
scripts.ci:js:tui: npm run lint --workspace hermes-tui && npm run type-check --workspace hermes-tui && npm test --workspace hermes-tui
scripts.ci:js:desktop: npm run lint --workspace hermes && npm run type-check --workspace hermes && npm run test:ui --workspace hermes && npm run test:desktop:platforms --workspace hermes
scripts.ci:js:web: npm run lint --workspace web && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.postinstall: echo '✅ Browser tools ready. Run: python run_agent.py --help'
